In [[137 ABY]], members of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]'s [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Napdu]], as did the rogue [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Tes Vevec]]. The Rogues were able to evacuate [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], but the Rogue [[Hondo Karr]] deserted the Remnant to join forces with Vevec and search for proof that the Mandalorians had been betrayed by [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Yaga Auchs]].
